scope: Original JPEG conversion selector and RC destination byte-address/stride/register contract; static branch evidence, not pixel packing or executed DMA
address_convention: K is raw ARM64 offset; KVA=raw+ffffffc001000000

selector.branch: Original JPEG conversion branch, not all RC callers
selector.origin: K561b0/K561c4 write W+188/W+18c=0; K56268..56278 supplies target W+d8
selector.propagation: K5aa08/5be60/5be6c/59b44/597a4 preserve target compression/depth; K64938..6494c -> SetYcCompress K63128 -> K6315c stores0
selector.request_alias: K64a10 passes T=O+8, so O+100=T+f8; provider preserves it at J+100
selector.descriptor_word: J+98 is built from a buffer-range list retaining up to4 entries; it is not established as1 or as a plane count
selector.opaque_uninitialized_field: K63224(input0) returns without writing T+fc/J+104; not assumed zero

selected_destination.conditions: selector0; J+f8/fa=0; J+190=1; inherited X+10=0 gives J+114=0; builder sets J+188=0
selected_destination.labels: A=K2cd23c translated destination; W=u16[J+e0]; Vx/Vy=u16[J+e4/e6]; rectangle x/y=s16+0/+2,w/h=u32+4/+8
selected_destination.address: P=A+2*((y+Vy)*W+x+Vx), subject to original integer widths
selected_destination.stride_relation: M14+M18=2*W with original arithmetic widths; byte stride does not identify component order
selected_destination.auxiliary: J108!=0 or J98==1 clears Z[0,28); J108==0/J98==2 calls2cd5d0; J98>=3 calls2cd7f4; no Cb/Cr-plane naming

dma_registers.channel_base: u64[Kbd9728+channel*18h+8], physical range not bound here

mode.scale: K2c9624 computes u64((w1<<12)+w2)*w5/u32(w3*w4); above20000h rejected, exactly20000h encoded0
mode.selector_bit: K2ccb20 sets bit8 for selector0; selectors1/7/9 clear it
mode.other_control: K2ce1e4 sets bits2:1 from J80 and whether R+c==1000h
